Hi Samir — sorry you're hitting this. Thanks for the logs. A couple quick asks that will help us repro and triage faster:

1) Can you confirm the exact request payload (we saw a very large metadata blob in your trace) — if you can paste the JSON body that would help.
2) What client timeout are you using? Our default SDK examples set a 30s HTTP timeout; lower values can surface internal queueing issues as 5xxs.
3) Are you targeting the hosted endpoint (api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings) or a private endpoint?

I'll have David take the first pass on the logs — looping him in. In the meantime a safe workaround is to increase your client timeout to 45s and enable retries with exponential backoff (max 3).

Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finlytics.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T17:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: FinLytics + Redwood integration (next steps)

Hey team — David from Runtime here. I pulled the logs in finlytics-embeddings-5xx-logs.zip and ran the curl repro locally. Quick notes:

- Repro: I can reproduce a 500 when the payload includes a nested "session.trace" string that exceeds ~8k characters; the runtime's JSON parser path has a bug that raises an unhandled exception for extremely large nested metadata fields. Error trace points to a memcopy in parser.c (stack attached in logs).
- Mitigation: Trim or remove the large "session.trace" blob from metadata. If you need to keep it, send it as a separate upload (S3 link) and include a reference in metadata instead.
- Timeouts: your 10s client timeout was low; during peak prefix cache population some requests can take longer. Use >=30s and enable retries (exponential backoff).
- Short-term fix: We pushed a guard on parser path to our staging runtime and can push a hotfix to production today once we've validated.

I'm attaching a small curl snippet that omits the large metadata (also added to curl-repro.txt):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embedding-2x-large","input":["short text sample"],"metadata":{"user_id":"u-9876"}}'

I'll coordinate the hotfix with infra and will update this thread when we push to prod. For now please try increasing the timeout and removing the large nested trace and confirm.

Thanks,
David Kim
Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.ai
